tool_schemas.name: crm_create_company
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new company CRM object using the provided property values and optionally creates the specified associations, returning the created company record (including its id and stored properties). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, property values don’t match the expected types/allowed values (for example invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), or association payloads are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create companies or associations; and raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when the request attempts an unsupported association type for companies or otherwise violates association constraints enforced by the CRM model.

tool_schemas.name: crm_update_company
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing company identified by companyId with the provided property changes and returns the updated company record. Raises NOT_FOUND when companyId does not exist (or is archived and cannot be updated), VALIDATION_ERROR when property values are invalid (including invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot update companies, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when the update is refused due to an invalid state transition supported by the model (for example attempting to update a record that is not eligible for modification).

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_company
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single company by companyId and returns the company record with the requested properties and, when requested, associated object ids for supported association names (contacts, deals, tickets). Raises NOT_FOUND when the company does not exist (or is archived and not retrievable in the current context), VALIDATION_ERROR when requested property or association names are invalid/unsupported, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. If properties is omitted, the endpoint returns the default property set stored for the object.

tool_schemas.name: crm_search_companies
tool_schemas.description: Searches companies using one or more filterGroups and returns a paged result set of matching companies including the requested properties, ordered by the optional sorts; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the opaque after cursor returned by the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are malformed, operators are incompatible with the property type, BETWEEN/IN operators are missing values, limit is out of range, or sorts reference invalid properties; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks company search/read permission; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Returns an empty page when no companies match, and raises NOT_FOUND only when a referenced property definition required to evaluate the query does not exist in the synced schema.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_create_companies
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple companies in a single request and returns a batch result containing the created company records for successful inputs along with per-input failures when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty or any input has invalid properties/associations (including invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), raises NOT_FOUND when any association target id referenced by an input does not exist, raises FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create companies, and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when any input requests an unsupported association type for companies or violates association constraints enforced by the CRM model.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_update_companies
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple companies in one request and returns a batch result with per-company success records and per-input errors. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty or any item is missing id/properties or contains invalid property values, raises NOT_FOUND when an id does not exist (or is archived and cannot be updated), raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks update permission, and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when an update is refused due to a state transition or modification constraint enforced by the CRM model.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_company_properties
tool_schemas.description: Lists company property definitions from the synced schema and returns the set of properties, optionally including archived definitions when archived=true; if properties is provided, only those named definitions are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when requested property names are invalid, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to read CRM schemas, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when a requested property name does not exist in the company property schema.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_company_property
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new company property definition (name/label/type/fieldType/groupName plus optional options and flags) and returns the created property metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, type/fieldType are unsupported, options are invalid for the chosen type, or the name format is invalid; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot modify CRM schemas; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when a property with the same name already exists or when the requested definition conflicts with existing schema constraints.

tool_schemas.name: crm_list_objects
tool_schemas.description: Lists CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns a paged collection of records with the requested properties; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the opaque after cursor returned by the previous page, and archived controls whether archived records are included. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when objectType is unsupported, limit is out of range, or requested property names are invalid for the given type; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read permission for that object type; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Returns an empty page when no records match the requested criteria.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_object
tool_schemas.description: Gets a single CRM object of the given objectType by id and returns the object record with stored properties for that type. Raises NOT_FOUND when the object id does not exist for the specified type (or is archived and not retrievable in the current context), VALIDATION_ERROR when objectType is unsupported or requested property names are invalid for that type, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. If no property selection is provided, the endpoint returns the default property set for the object type.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_object
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new CRM object of the specified objectType with the provided properties and optional initial associations, and returns the created object including its assigned id (and any created association links). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectType is unsupported, properties is missing/invalid, association entries are malformed, or associationTypeId/associationCategory are not valid for the from/to pair; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create that object type or to create the requested association links; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_update_object
tool_schemas.description: Updates the properties of an existing CRM object identified by objectId and returns the updated object. Raises NOT_FOUND if the objectId does not exist (or is not available in the synced dataset), VALIDATION_ERROR if properties is missing/invalid or contains values that fail type/format constraints, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to update that object type, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_archive_object
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) the CRM object identified by objectId and returns a success confirmation for the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the object does not exist, CONFLICT if the object is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state/constraints, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to archive that object type, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_search_objects
tool_schemas.description: Searches objects of the given objectType using filterGroups and returns a page of matching results; paging is cursor-based using limit (max 100) and the returned paging.after value, which you pass back as after to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are malformed, an operator is not supported for the property, required filter values are missing (e.g., BETWEEN/IN), sorts are invalid, or limit/after are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_create_objects
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-input results (created records and/or per-item errors) for the batch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/invalid, any item is missing properties, or any association specification is malformed/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create that object type or requested association links; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_read_objects
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType by objectIds (optionally using idProperty) and returns the requested properties and optional propertiesWithHistory for each requested id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectIds is missing/invalid, idProperty is invalid, or requested properties/propertiesWithHistory are not valid for the object type; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist (rather than failing the entire batch); raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_update_objects
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-input results (updated records and/or per-item errors). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/invalid, any item is missing id/properties, or any property value fails validation; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to update that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_archive_objects
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-id results for the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectIds is missing/invalid; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist; returns CONFLICT per object when it is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state/constraints; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to archive that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_list_association_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists the available association types that can be used between fromObjectType and toObjectType, returning the supported associationCategory and associationTypeId values for that pair. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either object type is unsupported, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read association metadata, NOT_FOUND if the object-type pair is not recognized by the backend, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_associations
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of associated toObjectType records (or association links) for the given fromObjectType/fromObjectId pair; paging is cursor-based using limit (max 500) and the returned paging.after value, which you pass back as after to fetch the next page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the from object does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if limit/after are invalid or the object-type pair is unsupported, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read either the from object or its associations, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_association
tool_schemas.description: Creates one or more association links from a source CRM object to a target CRM object using the provided association category and type IDs, and returns the created association(s). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any object type is unsupported, IDs are missing/invalid, or associationTypes is empty or contains malformed entries; raises NOT_FOUND if either object ID does not exist in the synced CRM subset. Raises CONFLICT if the requested association type cannot be applied between the given object types or the association already exists, and raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access or RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_archive_association
tool_schemas.description: Archives (removes) the association link between the specified source and target CRM objects and returns a confirmation of the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if object types or IDs are missing/invalid or the from/to types are unsupported, and raises NOT_FOUND if either object does not exist or no association exists between them to archive. Raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_create_associations
tool_schemas.description: Creates associations in bulk for the given from/to object types and returns per-input results indicating which associations were created (and which failed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fromObjectType/toObjectType are unsupported, inputs is empty/malformed, or any input is missing from.id, to.id, or types entries. Raises NOT_FOUND for inputs referencing objects that don’t exist in the synced CRM subset, CONFLICT for inputs whose association types are incompatible or already present, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota constraints are violated.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_archive_associations
tool_schemas.description: Archives (removes) multiple associations in one request for the given from/to object types and returns per-input results for each attempted archive. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fromObjectType/toObjectType are unsupported, inputs is empty/malformed, or any input is missing from.id or to.id. Raises NOT_FOUND for inputs where either object does not exist or no association exists to archive, and raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota constraints are violated.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_contact
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new contact using the provided properties and optional initial associations, and returns the created contact record (including its HubSpot ID and stored properties). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if properties are missing, if email/website formats are invalid, if enumerated fields (lifecyclestage/leadstatus) are outside the allowed values, or if associations payload entries are malformed. Raises CONFLICT when a unique constraint is violated (for example, an email already exists when uniqueness is enforced) and NOT_FOUND when an associated target object ID does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED for insufficient CRM write access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_update_contact
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing contact identified by contactId with the provided properties and returns the updated contact record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if contactId is missing/invalid, if provided property values fail validation (email/website formats, enum values), or if the properties object is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist in the synced CRM subset, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT if the update violates constraints (for example, setting email to a value that conflicts with another contact), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_contact
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single contact by ID and returns the contact record including the requested property fields and any requested association collections (companies, deals, tickets, calls, emails, meetings, notes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if contactId is missing/invalid or if requested associations contain unsupported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist in the synced CRM subset, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_search_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Searches contacts using filterGroups and optional sorts, returning a paged result set of matching contacts with the requested properties; paging uses limit (1–100) and the response provides an after cursor to pass back for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are missing or malformed, if operators are unsupported for the given filter shape (for example, missing value where required), if limit is out of range, or if sort directives are malformed. Raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_create_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Create multiple contacts in a single request

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_update_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Update multiple contacts in a single request

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_contact_properties
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of contact property definitions, optionally filtered to a specific set of property names and/or including archived properties when `archived` is true; the response is the full list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `properties` contains non-strings or invalid values, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema read access or the request exceeds applicable rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_contact_property
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new contact property definition in the specified `groupName` and returns the created property, including any configured options and display settings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, `type`/`fieldType` values are not supported, options are malformed (e.g., missing `label`/`value`), or option values are inconsistent with the chosen type; raises CONFLICT if a contact property with the same `name` already exists, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema write access or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_lead
tool_schemas.description: Creates a lead CRM object using the supplied `properties` (validating formats like `email` and `website`) and optional `associations`, and returns the newly created lead record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if property values fail schema/format validation, enum values (e.g., `leadstatus`, `rating`) are invalid, association payloads are malformed, or association type identifiers are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced associated object id does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_update_lead
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing lead identified by `leadId` with the provided `properties` and returns the updated lead record. Raises NOT_FOUND if `leadId` does not resolve to an existing lead, VALIDATION_ERROR if any provided property value is invalid (including enum/format constraints), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_lead
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single lead by `leadId` and returns it with the requested `properties` and any requested `associations` (e.g., companies, contacts, deals, notes, tasks). Raises NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if an unsupported association name is requested, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_search_leads
tool_schemas.description: Searches leads matching the provided `filterGroups` and returns a paged result set of leads containing the requested `properties`, sorted by `sorts`; pagination uses `limit` (1–100) and the returned `after` cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are malformed, use unsupported operators, reference invalid property names, or `limit` is out of range, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to search/read leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_create_leads
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple leads in one request from `inputs` and returns a batch result for each input (created record or error). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any input is missing required fields, contains invalid property formats/enums, or has malformed associations; raises NOT_FOUND when an input references a non-existent associated object id, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_batch_update_leads
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple existing leads in one request from `inputs` and returns a batch result for each input (updated record or error). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any input is malformed or contains invalid property formats/enums, NOT_FOUND for any input whose `id` does not match an existing lead, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update leads or is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_lead_properties
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of lead property definitions, optionally including archived properties when `archived` is true and optionally filtered to a provided set of property names; the response is the full list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `properties` is present but not an array of strings, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema read access or the request exceeds applicable rate limits.

tool_schemas.name: crm_create_lead_property
tool_schemas.description: Create a new lead property

tool_schemas.name: meetings_list
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of meeting CRM objects, optionally filtered by createdAfter/createdBefore, and optionally projecting only the requested properties; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, if after/createdAfter/createdBefore are not valid datetime strings, or if unknown parameters are supplied. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks read access to meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single meeting by meetingId, including the requested properties and (when requested) associations to contacts, companies, and/or deals. Raises NOT_FOUND when no meeting exists for meetingId, VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingId is missing/invalid or an associations value is not one of the supported types, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks read access to meetings. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a meeting CRM object with the provided required properties (hs_timestamp, hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time) and optional properties, and optionally creates the specified associations; returns the created meeting record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, when hs_meeting_outcome is not one of SCHEDULED/COMPLETED/CANCELED, when additional unsupported properties are provided, or when association specs are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for meetings, NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, CONFLICT when an association type/category is not valid for the target object, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing meeting identified by meetingId with the provided mutable properties and returns the updated meeting record. Raises NOT_FOUND when meetingId does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the update payload contains unsupported fields or an invalid hs_meeting_outcome value, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks update permissions for meetings. Raises CONFLICT when the requested update is not allowed due to the meeting’s current state and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) the meeting identified by meetingId and returns an acknowledgment of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND when meetingId does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingId is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks archive permissions for meetings. Raises CONFLICT when the meeting cannot be archived due to its current state and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches for meetings using filterGroups (AND within a group, OR across groups), returning a paged result set with optional property projection and optional sorting; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor from the prior page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are malformed, operators are not supported, required filter fields are missing, sorts are malformed, or limit/after are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks read access to meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple meetings in a single request and returns per-input results for successfully created records (and errors for failed inputs), applying the same validation rules as meetings_create to each input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, when any input is malformed, or when an input contains unsupported properties/invalid enum values; individual inputs may also fail with NOT_FOUND for missing association targets or CONFLICT for invalid association types. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple existing meetings in a single request and returns per-input results, applying the same validation rules as meetings_update to each input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, when any input is missing id/properties, or when an input contains unsupported fields/invalid enum values; individual inputs may fail with NOT_FOUND for unknown ids or CONFLICT for disallowed updates in the record’s current state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks update permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: meetings_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) multiple meetings identified by meetingIds and returns per-id results indicating success or failure. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingIds is missing/empty or contains invalid ids; individual ids may fail with NOT_FOUND when the meeting does not exist or CONFLICT when the meeting cannot be archived due to its current state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks archive permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a note CRM object with the provided properties (hs_note_body required; hs_timestamp and hubspot_owner_id optional) and optional associations, returning the created note record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when hs_note_body is missing, when the payload is malformed, or when association specs are malformed; note properties may include additional fields supported by the note object schema. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for notes, NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, CONFLICT when an association type/category is not valid for the target object, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single note by noteId, including its properties and (when requested) associated contacts/companies/deals/tickets, and can limit the response to the requested property names. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid, if requested associations include unsupported values, or if the properties list is not an array of strings; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist (or is not available in the synced subset); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing note’s writable properties (hs_note_body required; optionally hs_timestamp and hubspot_owner_id) and returns the updated note. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid, hs_note_body is missing/empty, or any provided property value is of the wrong type; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist (or is not available in the synced subset); raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT if the note is archived and cannot be updated, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (soft-deletes) the note identified by noteId and returns a success response for the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks archive/delete permission, CONFLICT if the note is already archived, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists notes with cursor-based pagination using limit (1–100) and after, returning results plus paging information when more pages are available; you may request specific properties and include requested associations, and you can include archived records by setting archived=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, after is malformed, properties is not an array of strings, or associations contain unsupported values; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches notes using filterGroups and optional sorts, returning a paged result set using limit (1–100) and after along with paging metadata when additional results are available; you may also request specific properties in the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are missing or malformed, an operator is unsupported, required filter fields are absent, sorts are invalid, or limit/after are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple notes in a single request from the inputs array and returns per-input created records (and/or per-item errors) including any requested associations created via the supplied association types. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/malformed, any item is missing required properties.hs_note_body, or association payloads are invalid (missing to.id or types); raises NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write/associate permissions, CONFLICT when an item cannot be created due to state constraints, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_batch_read
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple notes by id in a single request and returns the matching notes (and/or per-item errors), optionally including only the requested properties and specified associations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/malformed, an input id is missing/invalid, or associations/properties are invalid; returns NOT_FOUND for any note id that does not exist while still processing other items; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple notes in a single request and returns the updated notes (and/or per-item errors), applying the same writable property rules as single-note updates (hs_note_body required per item). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/malformed, any item is missing id or required properties, or values are of the wrong type; returns NOT_FOUND for any note id that does not exist while still processing other items; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT for items that are archived and cannot be updated, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: notes_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (soft-deletes) multiple notes identified by noteIds and returns per-id results (and/or per-item errors). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteIds is missing, not an array, or contains invalid ids; returns NOT_FOUND for any id that does not exist while still processing other ids; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks archive/delete permission, CONFLICT for ids that are already archived, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task CRM object with the provided properties (hs_task_body and hs_task_subject required; optional priority/status/type/timestamps/due date/owner) and optional associations, and returns the created task including its id and stored properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, enums (priority/status) are invalid, date/timestamp fields are malformed, or association payloads are invalid (missing to.id or types); raises NOT_FOUND if an association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write/associate permissions and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single task by taskId, optionally projecting only the requested properties and including associated records for the requested association types (contacts, companies, deals, tickets). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskId is missing/invalid, if requested properties are not valid task properties, or if associations contains unsupported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or is not accessible to the caller) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read tasks.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task’s properties for the given taskId and returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject) are missing, if any provided enum value is invalid (priority/status), or if taskId is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks. Raises CONFLICT if the task is archived and cannot be updated.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) the task identified by taskId and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to archive tasks. Raises CONFLICT if the task is already archived.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks, optionally including only the requested properties, including requested associations, and filtering by archived state; results are paged with limit (1–100) and an after cursor returned in the paging block for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, after is malformed, requested properties are invalid, or associations contains unsupported values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to list tasks.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches for tasks matching the provided filterGroups and returns a paged result set ordered by the optional sorts; pagination uses limit (1–100) and an after cursor returned with the response for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups is empty/invalid, if a filter operator is unsupported for the property or missing required values (e.g., BETWEEN without bounds), if sorts are malformed, or if requested properties are invalid. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to search tasks.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks from the inputs array and returns the created task records, applying any provided associations at creation time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, if any input is missing required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject), if enum values are invalid, or if association type payloads are malformed. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create tasks and NOT_FOUND if an association target id does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_batch_read
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple tasks by id and returns the task records, optionally projecting requested properties and including requested association types per input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, any id is missing/invalid, requested properties are invalid, or associations contains unsupported values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read tasks and NOT_FOUND for any task id that does not exist (or is not accessible).

tool_schemas.name: tasks_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple existing tasks and returns the updated task records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, if any input is missing id or required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject), or if enum values are invalid; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update tasks. Raises NOT_FOUND if any task id does not exist and CONFLICT if any referenced task is archived and cannot be updated.

tool_schemas.name: tasks_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) all tasks listed in taskIds and returns an empty success response when the operation completes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskIds is empty/invalid or contains invalid ids, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to archive tasks. Raises NOT_FOUND for any task id that does not exist and CONFLICT for any task that is already archived.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns the engagement-like activity object identified by engagementId. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if engagementId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the engagement does not exist (or is not accessible to the caller), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read engagements.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new engagement object (EMAIL, CALL, MEETING, TASK, or NOTE) with the provided engagement fields, optional metadata, and optional associations to contacts/companies/deals/tickets/owners, and returns the created engagement record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing (at minimum engagement.type and engagement.title), if enum values are invalid, or if association arrays are not arrays of IDs; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create engagements. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded and CONFLICT when the request attempts an unsupported association shape or duplicates that cannot be applied atomically.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing engagement’s details and optional metadata by engagementId and returns the updated engagement record. Raises NOT_FOUND if engagementId does not exist (or is not accessible), VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including engagement.type and engagement.title) or values violate enum/format constraints, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the engagement. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded and CONFLICT if the engagement is in a state that cannot be modified or the update would apply an unsupported/invalid change set.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists engagements, optionally filtered by startTime/endTime and activityTypes, and returns a page of results. Pagination is offset-based: provide limit (1–100) and offset to fetch the next page; the response includes the current slice of engagements in that window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/offset or malformed filters, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list engagements, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) an engagement by engagementId and returns confirmation of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the engagementId does not exist (or is not accessible) and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive engagements. Raises CONFLICT if the engagement is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: engagement_details_get_associated
tool_schemas.description: Lists engagements associated with a specific CRM object (CONTACT, COMPANY, DEAL, or TICKET) and returns a paged result set, optionally filtered by time range and activityTypes. Pagination is offset-based: use limit (1–100) and offset to page through associated engagements for the given objectId. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid objectType/filters/paging parameters, NOT_FOUND if the referenced object does not exist (or is not accessible), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read associations/engagements, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Call CRM object with the provided call properties and optional associations, and returns the created call record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties are missing (hs_call_body and hs_call_title), if enums/URI formats are invalid, or if association inputs do not match the required {to, types} structure; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create call records. Raises NOT_FOUND if an association target id cannot be resolved, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the requested association types cannot be applied to a call.

tool_schemas.name: calls_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a call by callId and returns the call record, optionally including only the requested properties and the requested association types (contacts/companies/deals/tickets). Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible) and VALIDATION_ERROR if requested properties/associations are malformed or unsupported. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read call records and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing call record’s properties by callId and returns the updated call record. Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible), VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties are missing or values violate enum/format constraints (including hs_call_body and hs_call_title), and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit calls. Raises CONFLICT if the call is archived or otherwise not editable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) a call record by callId and returns confirmation of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible) and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive calls. Raises CONFLICT if the call is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists call records and returns a paged result set, optionally including selected properties, selected association types, and archived results. Pagination is cursor-based: provide limit (1–100) and use the returned paging cursor as after to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/after or malformed properties/associations, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list calls, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches call CRM objects using one or more filterGroups and returns a paged result set of matching calls, including only the requested properties and applying optional sorts; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filterGroups is missing/empty, a filter is missing propertyName/operator, an operator is not supported, or limit is outside 1–100. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access to read calls, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple call CRM objects in one request and returns per-input results for the created calls (including their IDs), creating any provided associations when the association type identifiers are valid. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, any input lacks required properties (hs_call_body, hs_call_title), an enum/URI field is invalid, or an association payload is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when an association refers to a target object ID that does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create calls or associations, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_batch_read
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple calls by ID and returns a result for each requested ID, optionally including selected properties and the requested association sets (contacts/companies/deals/tickets). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, an input is missing id, or an associations value is not one of the supported types. Raises NOT_FOUND for any call ID that does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to read calls, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple existing call CRM objects and returns per-input results for the updated calls. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, any input lacks id or required properties (hs_call_body, hs_call_title), or any enum/URI field is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when a call ID does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to update calls, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: calls_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) multiple call CRM objects by ID and returns a batch result indicating which archives succeeded. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when callIds is missing/empty or contains invalid IDs. Raises NOT_FOUND for any call ID that does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to archive calls, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates an email CRM object and returns the created email, including its ID and any requested associations created in the same request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields (hs_email_subject, hs_email_text, hs_email_from_email, hs_email_to_email) are missing, email/enum fields are invalid, or association payloads are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when an association refers to a target object ID that does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create emails or associations, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single email CRM object by ID and returns it with the requested properties and optional association sets (contacts/companies/deals/tickets). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when emailId is missing or an associations value is not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND when the emailId does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to read emails, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing email CRM object by ID and returns the updated email. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when emailId or properties is missing, required fields (hs_email_subject, hs_email_text, hs_email_from_email, hs_email_to_email) are missing from the update payload, or email/enum fields are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when the emailId does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to update emails, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) an email CRM object by ID and returns success when the email is archived. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when emailId is missing. Raises NOT_FOUND when the emailId does not exist, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to archive emails, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists email CRM objects and returns a paged collection, optionally including selected properties, requested association sets, and optionally including archived records when archived=true; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit is outside 1–100 or an associations value is not one of the supported types. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to list emails, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches email CRM objects using one or more filter groups, optionally returning only the requested properties, and returns a paged result set of matching emails sorted as requested (use `limit` and the `after` cursor from the response to paginate). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `filterGroups` is missing/empty, a filter is missing `propertyName`/`operator`, an operator is not supported, `limit` is outside 1–100, or a sort is missing `propertyName`/`direction`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read emails, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple email CRM objects in a single call and returns the created records (and any requested association links provided per input). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `inputs` is missing/empty, any input is missing `properties`, required properties are missing (`hs_email_subject`, `hs_email_text`, `hs_email_from_email`, `hs_email_to_email`), an email address field is not a valid email, or association specs are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create emails or create the specified associations, NOT_FOUND if an association target id does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_batch_read
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple email CRM objects by id and returns the requested properties and optional association expansions for each input item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `inputs` is missing/empty, any input is missing `id`, or an association name is not one of the supported values (`contacts`, `companies`, `deals`, `tickets`). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read emails, NOT_FOUND for any id that does not correspond to an email, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple email CRM objects by id and returns the updated records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `inputs` is missing/empty, any input is missing `id` or `properties`, required properties are missing within `properties` (as defined by the schema), or any email-formatted field is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update emails, NOT_FOUND for any email id that does not exist, CONFLICT if an update attempts a state change the backend refuses for the current record, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: emails_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (soft-deletes) multiple email CRM objects by id and returns a batch archive result indicating which ids were archived. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `emailIds` is missing/empty. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive emails, NOT_FOUND for any id that does not exist, CONFLICT if an email cannot be archived due to its current state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_get_preferences
tool_schemas.description: Returns a contact’s communication subscription preferences; when `subscriptionId` is provided, the response is scoped to that subscription, otherwise it returns the contact’s preferences across subscriptions tracked by this portal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contactId` is missing or `subscriptionId` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read communication preferences, NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist (or if a specified subscription definition does not exist), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_update_preferences
tool_schemas.description: Updates a contact’s preference for the specified subscription and returns the updated preference record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contactId`, `subscriptionId`, or `preferences` is missing, if `preferences.subscriptionId` does not match the path `subscriptionId`, if `status`/`legalBasis` values are not supported, or if required fields for the update are missing. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update communication preferences, NOT_FOUND if the contact or subscription definition does not exist, CONFLICT if the update is refused due to the contact’s current subscription state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_unsubscribe_contact
tool_schemas.description: Unsubscribes a contact from all email communications for the portal and returns the contact’s updated global email subscription status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contactId` is missing or provided legal-basis fields are not supported. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update communication preferences, NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist, CONFLICT if the unsubscribe cannot be applied due to the current preference state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_subscribe_contact
tool_schemas.description: Subscribes a contact to all email communications for the portal and returns the contact’s updated global email subscription status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contactId` is missing or provided legal-basis fields are not supported. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update communication preferences, NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist, CONFLICT if the subscribe cannot be applied due to the current preference state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_get_subscription_definitions
tool_schemas.description: Returns the portal’s communication subscription definitions, optionally including archived definitions when `archived` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `archived` is not a boolean when provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read subscription definitions, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: communications_get_subscription_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current communication subscription status for each contact ID in `contactIds` for the specified `subscriptionId`. The response includes one result per requested contact (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `subscriptionId` is missing/invalid or `contactIds` is empty/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read communication subscriptions, and NOT_FOUND if the subscription definition does not exist (unknown contact IDs are returned as missing/NOT_FOUND per contact result).

tool_schemas.name: communications_update_subscription_status
tool_schemas.description: Sets the communication subscription `status` for each contact in `updates` under the specified `subscriptionId`, optionally recording `legalBasis` and `legalBasisExplanation`, and returns the per-contact update results (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, `status`/`legalBasis` values are not in the allowed enums, or an update item is malformed; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify subscription preferences; and NOT_FOUND if the subscription definition does not exist (unknown contact IDs are rejected per item).

tool_schemas.name: products_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists products, returning a single page of product records and only the requested `properties` (or the default property set when omitted). Results are paged with `limit` and the opaque cursor `after`; when more results exist the response includes `paging.next.after` which you pass as the next request’s `after`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid `limit`, malformed `after`, or unknown property names, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read products.

tool_schemas.name: products_read
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single product by `productId`, returning the requested `properties` and any requested `associations` expansions supported by the product object. Raises NOT_FOUND if no product exists for `productId`, VALIDATION_ERROR if `productId`/property names/association names are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read products or their associations.

tool_schemas.name: products_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a product using the supplied `properties` and returns the newly created product record including its assigned ID. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when provided properties fail type/format validation, contain unknown property names, or violate required-field rules enforced by the product schema; CONFLICT if a unique property constraint is violated (for example a unique SKU, when configured); and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create products.

tool_schemas.name: products_update
tool_schemas.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by ID. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

tool_schemas.name: products_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives the product identified by `productId` (moves it to the recycle bin) and returns an empty success response. Raises NOT_FOUND if the product does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if `productId` is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive products.

tool_schemas.name: products_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches for products matching the optional free-text `query` and the required `filterGroups`, returning a page of matching products with the requested `properties`. Results are paged with `limit` and `after` and may include `paging.next.after` for subsequent pages; ordering is controlled via `sorts` when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter definitions/operators/values, invalid `limit`/`after`, or unknown property names, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot search/read products.

tool_schemas.name: products_batch_archive
tool_schemas.description: Archives (recycles) all products listed in `productIds` and returns per-ID results indicating success or failure for each input (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `productIds` is empty or contains invalid IDs, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive products, and returns NOT_FOUND per item for any IDs that do not correspond to an existing product.

tool_schemas.name: products_batch_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple products from `inputs` and returns per-input results including each created product’s ID and properties (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any input is malformed or contains invalid/unknown properties, CONFLICT per item when a unique property constraint would be violated, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create products.

tool_schemas.name: products_batch_read
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple products identified by `productIds`, optionally using `idProperty` to treat those values as a custom unique key, and returns the requested `properties` plus `propertiesWithHistory` where available (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `productIds` is empty, `idProperty` is not a valid unique property, or requested property names are invalid; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read products; and returns NOT_FOUND per item for any IDs/unique-key values that do not resolve to a product.

tool_schemas.name: products_batch_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates multiple Product records in a single request, matching each input by its internal object ID or by the unique property named in `idProperty`, and returns the updated Product objects for the successfully processed inputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `inputs` is empty, an input is missing `id` or `properties`, or a provided property value is of the wrong type; raises NOT_FOUND when an input references no existing Product for the given identifier; and raises CONFLICT when an `idProperty` value is not unique or the request attempts an invalid update that the Product schema does not allow.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the current credential, including portal/tenant context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHENTICATED when no valid credential is provided and FORBIDDEN when the credential is not permitted to access this portal.

credential.description: Authentication material used to access the portal-scoped data.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for the HubSpot account/portal.

tool_schemas.name: crm_restore_object
tool_schemas.description: Restores an archived CRM object by setting its status to active and archived=false, returning the restored object record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the object does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the object cannot be restored due to portal policy, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot restore the object type, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

objectType.description: CRM object type of the record to restore (for example: companies, contacts, deals, tickets, leads, meetings, notes, tasks, calls, emails, engagements, or a custom object type).

objectId.description: Internal id of the CRM object to restore.

credential.description: Authentication material used to access the portal-scoped data.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for the HubSpot account/portal.

tool_schemas.name: crm_get_association_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists active association types available in the portal for the provided fromObjectType/toObjectType pair, returning association category, type id, and labels. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when object types are invalid/unsupported, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot read association metadata, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

fromObjectType.description: Source object type for the association types to list.

toObjectType.description: Target object type for the association types to list.

status.description: Filter returned association types by lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of association types to return.

after.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; use the value returned in the previous response to fetch the next page.

credential.description: Authentication material used to access the portal-scoped data.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for the HubSpot account/portal.

metadata.name: HubSpot MCP
metadata.description: This backend persists a synced subset of HubSpot CRM data (objects, their typed properties, and relationships) so the MCP tools can create/read/update/search/archive CRM entities and manage their associations. It also stores engagement-like activities (meetings, notes, tasks, calls, emails) as CRM o
